get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with default or turbo inference settings
get_reference_energies: get atomic or formation elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from the HuggingFace Hub
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a pretrained model by name
list_available_models: list all available pretrained model names from the fairchem pretrained models registry
review_HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass fields including filename, repo_id, subfolder, revision, atom_refs, and form_elem_refs
